topic.title: Why Overtrading Can Destroy Good Decision-Making

research.summary: Overtrading can happen when boredom, frustration, or the need to recover a loss starts driving decisions. A disciplined trader can spend more time waiting than clicking. Build a checklist, define what qualifies as a setup, and learn to do nothing when the chart does not meet your conditions. Patience is part of the strategy.
